note: The four repeated subject columns use report-local ordinals. Each source score summarizes observed symptom grade and duration under the authors' scoring rule. Planned flight settings apply to the table, with possible early descent.

citation: First Testing of BLB Mask in Low Pressure Chamber Using Rates of Oxygen Flow Calculated to Maintain Normal Alveolar pO2 (Preliminary Denitrogenation). Wright Field Aero Medical Laboratory, 11 April 1938. In Studies in Aviation Medicine, vol. 6.
locator: April 11, 1938 Wright Field notes, NLM v. 6 image 29 and April 11, 1938 Wright Field log table, NLM v. 6 image 30.
note: A selected equipment test with two occupants, different equipment and different preparations. The test mask occupant received about 30 minutes of pure oxygen before ascent. The accompanying occupant skipped prebreathe and used the laboratory mask at about 10 L/min STPD. The tabulated target and measured flow apply only to the test mask circuit. Numbered alveolar assays are paired readings in the same row, not outcomes for the two occupants.
